name: Creamy Parmesan Pork Chops Skillet
unmapped: basil (dried basil has no board id; minor spice), bone-broth maps to chicken-broth on board
why: Whole-muscle boneless pork chops, pan-seared then finished in a parmesan-cream pan sauce - no rice/pasta/potato base, so structurally low-carb. Published nutrition 571 cal / 7g carbs / 38g protein per serving sits dead center of the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band with strong protein. Skillet dish, weigh-and-divide-friendly, scales cleanly to 14. Distinct from existing creamy-mushroom-pork-chops-over-mashed-potatoes (that one is mushroom gravy over mashed potatoes; this is an onion-parmesan cream sauce, no starch base). Board covers pork-chops, butter, olive-oil, onions, garlic, chicken-broth, heavy-cream, parmesan, garlic-powder, dried-parsley.
